lines.text: Har har! Yer gold and yer teeth be mine!
lines.spoken: Harr harr! Yer gold, and yer teeth, be mine!

lines.text: Your ship sank before it left the dock.
Fetch me a mop. There is a landlubber on my deck.
I have buried treasure deeper than you will ever get up from.
Fire on deck does not scare me, lass. I keep my own beard lit.
